claims.supported_claim: INSERT RETURNING reports inserted/updated rows; DO NOTHING cannot be assumed to return an existing row.
claims.limitations: Version18 documentation observed2026-11-12; not a pinned server executable or PG runtime experiment.

claims.supported_claim: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING may conflict with a concurrent transaction not visible to the same statement snapshot; a later statement has a new ReadCommitted snapshot.
claims.limitations: Does not by itself prove the whole idempotency implementation; retention, recovery and real PG concurrency tests remain required.

claims.supported_claim: Five actual SQLite prototype assertions passed: replay, hash conflict,4-connection race with1 effect, actual commit plus simulated response loss, and real precommit process exit17 with atomic rollback then retry.
limitations: Response loss simulated after actual COMMIT, not a network proxy fault
Process exit is not OS power-loss/fsync hardware verification

selected_design.decision: Single-transaction scoped idempotency/result/business/outbox and explicit Commit Unknown recovery; C# application/syntax/DTO layer over mandatory Rust ORM and PostgreSQL/SQLite Database Engine, with Kestrel default and optional Rust Server.

product_scope_constraint.source: Explicit user direction relayed by integrator during this session
product_scope_constraint.database_execution: Rust required for query semantics, SQL generation, ORM, drivers, pool and transaction execution; C# supplies syntax capture/diagnostics/versioned IR encoding/static DTO boundary and public generic/LINQ/async/AOT surface
product_scope_constraint.superseded_draft: Managed Npgsql/Microsoft.Data.Sqlite default product path and optional-only Rust DB
product_scope_constraint.implementation_verification: Rust DB and related Core interop/AOT remain required delivery evidence, not satisfied by this Python experiment
product_scope_constraint.selected_orm_reference: SeaORM route from D14/D16; schema-specific generated Entity/ActiveModel/dispatcher plus common Rust DB code statically linked in one native module; new model build requires Rust toolchain locally or CI. R31 did not execute this implementation.
